main.description: What a context's projector shows, for whoever may read the context. A context nobody has set one for shows nothing.

active_id.description: The node on screen. During a vote it is the open poll.

focus.description: A heading anchor within it, for a document too long to show whole.

canvas_id.description: The canvas the context shows where it shows one: the room's board. A setting of its own, since a board is up beside whatever is on the screen.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such context, or none the caller may read.
